title: How To Get The GTA Online UFO Rewards 2026
description: Guide to obtaining the Shocker weapon and Gray Space Interloper outfit during the 2026 UFO event week in GTA Online.
youtubeTitle: GTA Online UFO Rewards 2026: Free Shocker & Gray Outfit
socialHook: GTA Online players can claim the free Shocker weapon and Gray Space Interloper outfit this week.

sections.heading: UFO Event Status in 2026
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL reports that as of October 23, 2026, the annual UFO event has not appeared in GTA Online, but the publisher has launched a special Event Week that makes two previously limited‑time rewards available to all players. This development comes less than a month before the anticipated release of Grand Theft Auto VI.

sections.heading: Obtaining the Shocker Melee Weapon
paragraphs: According to RockstarINTEL, the Shocker melee weapon, which was originally introduced as a reward during the 2024 UFO event, can be obtained for free from the Gun Van, and the vendor's inventory rotates daily, requiring players to check the map for its current location.

sections.heading: Gray Space Interloper Outfit and Speculation
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL also states that the Gray Space Interloper outfit, earned last year by escaping the Fort Zancudo bunker, is available this week by completing all waves of a Survival challenge, which also grants a GTA$150,000 bonus. Additionally, the outlet notes that fans are speculating about the possible return of Halloween weather, though this remains unconfirmed.
